seo.title: Our Gym — ATHLETIX
seo.description: A purpose-built strength and conditioning facility in Fortitude Valley, Brisbane — designed around how athletes actually train.

blocks.title: OUR
blocks.lede: A purpose-built facility in Fortitude Valley designed around how athletes actually train — lift, sprint, recover, repeat.

Every square metre of Athletix has been built around the way elite athletes train. From olympic platforms and force plates to a 30m sprint track and dedicated mobility studio, the floor is engineered for results.

items.title: Lifting Platforms
items.desc: Eight Olympic platforms with calibrated bumpers and mixed loading options.

items.title: Sprint Track
items.desc: Indoor 30m sprint lane with timing gates and force plates for objective measurement.

items.title: Force Plates
items.desc: VALD ForceDecks for jump, landing and asymmetry profiling — included in athlete tier.

items.title: Mobility Studio
items.desc: Dedicated space for Pilates, mobility flows and warm-ups, away from the lifting floor.

items.title: Allied Health Suite
items.desc: Private rooms for physiotherapy and rehab — seamlessly integrated with your coaching team.

items.title: In-house Cafe
items.desc: Refuel post-session with proper coffee and high-protein options without leaving the building.
